resources.string: Tired of entering a password every time your computer goes to sleep? Portal takes the hassle out of it by turning your smartphone into a smart wireless key.\n\nYou can unlock your PC in advance as you walk up to your desk, or configure it to send a request straight to your phone. A single touch to the biometric sensor, and you\'re in. Fast, secure, and with zero extra steps.
Portal is a completely open-source project (GPL-3.0). No hidden in-app purchases, paid limitations, or annoying ads. The source code and developer contacts are waiting for you below.

For the app to work correctly, you must provide the following permissions. You have the right to refuse to grant all or some permissions, but in this case, some functions of the application may not be available.
It is used to display PC unlock notifications and background work.
This permission is required by the app if you use Bluetooth to unlock your device.
This permission is required to display device unlock prompts on top of all windows. This allows you to instantly grant or deny access without unlocking your phone or opening the app.
To ensure all features work correctly in the background, please disable battery optimization for this app.
